To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the balancing circuit must be able to balance the charge of all cells, even when a cell is completely discharged, 2) the circuit must be able not to affect the battery operation, 3) the circuit must not introduce additional power losses and 4) the circuit must allow the balancing of the battery during the normal operation, without the need of interrupting it.

1. the charge unbalance in a series-connected battery is a limiting factor for the performance of the battery; 2. the charge unbalancing problem can be efficiently addressed by a simple circuit that uses the energy stored in the battery to balance the charge; 3. the proposed circuit can be used in a variety of applications and is particularly suitable for electric vehicles.

1) the balancing of a battery is a very efficient way to improve the battery performance, especially when the battery is operated in a partial charge regime; 2) a simple and efficient circuit to balance the battery is a series connection of a diode and an inductor; 3) the inductor is the key component of the circuit, because it allows to store energy when the battery is charged and then to deliver the stored energy when the battery needs it.
